title: Twist Bioscience Corporation August 2026 underwritten common-stock offering
excerpt: Twist sold 3,125,000 shares at USD 96 and the underwriters exercised an option for 468,750 additional shares; expected net proceeds were approximately USD 327.1 million.
summary: The SEC filing documents a completed financing that materially increases cash resources while raising the common-share denominator by 3,593,750 shares.
